"Ys 3: Wanderers from Ys" on the SNES.

If you've never heard of Ys (pronounced 'ease') then you're probably not Japanese. It's a series so celebrated in Japan that it almost has it's own holiday. Outside of Japan, it's a little-known super-unforgiving fantasy action RPG series with a (mostly) top-down perspective. It generally has no attack button as you simply walk forward into your enemies, avoiding contact from all sides that aren't your front.

Ys 3 is the black sheep of the family, since it's a sidescrolling platforming fantasy action RPG, in which the use of an attack button is mandatory. If you've played Ys, you likely aren't a fan of 3 and might have never played it at all. I personally don't mind the change in mechanics, and think Wanderers can stand on its own merits, though it makes for a very strange Ys game.
